note: Release v0.1.4 vs no fixes of ours (README benchmark). 12 jobs: per world (BP, SV, IP) ABBA = base, rel, rel, base; 10 min seeded profile runs (seed 12345) like the H6 env runs. Both sides run game-copy/ts3native.asi.rel0360 (ts3native 0.36.0); the community stack (DXVK, S3SS, S3PP as installed) is the same on both. Clean night only (timing). Report: node tools/release-vs-baseline-report.ts [--date YYYY-MM-DD]. Save time is not benchmarked here: save-matrix.ts --fixes shipped never switches the save fixes (SaveWrite/Decompress are ini-only) and --fixes all also flips fixes the release does not ship (cachedreflection, save compress/flush), and fixesOff is profile-only, so there is no clean timed on/off control save.

jobs.note: Baseline side, run 1 of 2 on Bridgeport: same asi, every section the release ini enables set Enabled=0 (GC, RouteAsync, SaveWrite, Decompress, WaterJps, RouteGate, Discourage, LotRemoveGuard, OptsInit), and every default-on ts3fixes switch off for the whole window (profile.fixesOff, read back by profile-world.ts). kWalkStyleComparer has no runtime switch and stays on (install-time patch, sort comparer only). Measures the game with the community stack (DXVK, S3SS, ...) and no fixes of ours, same 10 min seeded window (seed 12345, test_env on). ABBA order per world (base, rel, rel, base) cancels drift; tools/release-vs-baseline-report.ts averages the two runs per side. Pass: 0 crashes, 0 watchdog lines, a full 600 s profile window (seconds.csv ~600 rows), machine load ok (probe-out/queue/<tag>-*-machine.jsonl: other CPU < 10% on average and clock not below 80% of its first sample, noise low or medium; else rerun this job at a clean night, memory external-load-check). Timing is only valid from a clean-night run.

Release side, run 1 of 2 on Bridgeport: ts3native 0.36.0 (v0.1.4) with the release ini as shipped (d6ff7a9; the enabled sections are pinned in ini so a later repo ini cannot change them) and ts3fixes with its shipped tuning (no switch overrides). Measures what v0.1.4 gives a player: sim iterations/s, hitches/min (>= 50 ms), p99 and worst iteration, sim-thread route ms/s over a 10 min seeded window (seed 12345, test_env on). ABBA order per world (base, rel, rel, base) cancels drift; tools/release-vs-baseline-report.ts averages the two runs per side.
